keyboard.title: Phonetic keyboard guide
keyboard.description: Type Roman letters and Bangla comes out. This is the whole table of what each key does, and it is generated from the practice engine's own rule file, so the guide and the engine can never disagree.
keyboard.how.title: How it works
keyboard.how.context: A vowel after a consonant becomes its sign: ami → আমি, gai → গাই. A lowercase o is the inherent vowel — after a consonant it writes nothing and only keeps two consonants apart (kor → কর, sokale → সকালে), while an uppercase O gives the o-kar (kO → কো).
keyboard.how.hasanta: Two consonants in a row take an automatic hasanta between them, so tto → ত্ত.
keyboard.how.commit: Press space to finish a word: that is what commits your Bangla as typed and starts the next word. Until then the word is still composing, so the on-screen board keeps its suggestion on the space bar.
keyboard.how.backspace: Backspace removes the last Roman keystroke and the whole word is rebuilt from what is left.
keyboard.how.dictionary: Words the rules cannot spell correctly have their own list — bhalo → ভালো is the classic case, since the reference spelling of it is bhalO.
keyboard.how.digits: Digits come out in Bengali numerals: 123 → ১২৩.
keyboard.sheet.title: The whole table
keyboard.status.reviewed: signed off by a native speaker
keyboard.note: Anything outside the table is passed through unchanged, so an unknown keystroke is never swallowed. Every line here is still awaiting a native speaker's final sign-off, so read the guide if you want the reasoning behind a rule.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.inputModeHint: System keyboard scores what your installed Bangla keyboard produces; built-in phonetic converts Roman keystrokes itself.
settings.fontSizeHint: The size of the words in the typing area.
settings.caretStyleHint: How the next character is marked: a vertical bar, an underline, or nothing.
settings.showAllLinesHint: When off, only the current line of words is shown, like a typewriter window.
settings.difficultyHint: Which texts the practice pool draws from.
settings.stopOnErrorHint: Letter mode refuses a wrong character; word mode refuses to commit a wrong word.
settings.blindModeHint: No correctness colours at all. Raw speed only.
settings.liveWpmHint: Show speed, accuracy and time while typing.
settings.numeralsHint: Render stats and results with Bengali digits.
settings.soundHint: Quiet synthesized feedback for keystrokes and mistakes.
settings.dataNote: Settings and results are stored in this browser only. Export, import and reset live on the progress page.
settings.storageUnavailable: This browser cannot store settings, so they only apply to this session.
settings.funboxHint: A twist on the word stream: digits, punctuation, reversed words, or words you have to remember.
settings.confidenceHint: On: backspacing stops at the word you are typing. Max: backspace does nothing at all.
settings.quickRestartHint: Which key throws the current text away and starts over.
settings.minWpmHint: The run ends as soon as speed drops below this. Four seconds of grace, so the first words do not count against you.
settings.minAccuracyHint: The run ends as soon as accuracy drops below this, once twenty clusters have been typed.
settings.capsLockWarningHint: Say something while caps lock is on; it changes what a phonetic keyboard produces.
settings.soundVolumeHint: How loud the keystroke and mistake blips are.
settings.indicateTyposHint: Show the letter you actually typed: under the word, in place of the letter, or not at all.
settings.hideExtraLettersHint: Do not draw letters typed past the end of a word.
settings.wordHistoryHint: List the words you typed: on the results screen, and while typing.
settings.focusModeHint: Fade the header and toolbar away while a test is running. They come back on keyboard focus.
settings.themeNote: Themes are shipped with the app; the export is a JSON copy for sharing.
settings.commandHintBody: Ctrl+K opens the palette, Ctrl+/ opens the command line. Also in the header.
settings.keyboardHint: Draw the keyboard below the words, with the next key to press highlighted.
settings.keyboardLayoutHint: Which fixed layout the on-screen keyboard shows in system keyboard mode.
settings.fingerColorsHint: Tint every key by the finger that reaches it.

progress.exportNote: Downloads one JSON file with your settings, history and error map. Nothing is uploaded.
progress.importNote: Reads a Type Kori backup file and replaces the data in this browser.

progress.resetDone: All data deleted from this browser.
progress.storageUnavailable: This browser is not storing anything, so history only lasts for this session.

lesson.failed: Not passed yet; 90% accuracy is the bar.
game.meta.title: Falling words: a Bangla typing game | Type Kori
game.meta.description: Type each Bangla word before it reaches the bottom. Three speeds, one goal: keep your accuracy while you get faster.
game.title: Falling words
game.lead: The words fall from the top. Finish each one before it reaches the bottom — every word that escapes costs you a life.
game.instructions: Words start falling as soon as you begin. What you have typed shows below them; a complete match clears the word. Keys that cannot lead to any word on screen are a miss, and the buffer resets. Backspace takes back the last character, and Escape pauses the round.
game.mode.system: You type with the Bangla keyboard your computer already has.
game.mode.builtin: Built-in phonetic mode is on: type Roman letters and Bangla appears, exactly as in the practice test.
game.footer: Escape pauses the round; Escape again resumes it.
game.reducedMotion: Your system asks for less motion, so the words do not fall — each one shows the time it has left instead.
game.over.title: Round over
game.over.score: Total score — one point per character typed
game.page.how.title: How it works
game.page.how.vocabulary: The words come from the practice library's own vocabulary, so even while playing you are drilling the words real sentences are made of.
game.page.how.motion: If your system asks for less motion, the words do not fall: each one shows the time it has left, and the rules are unchanged.
game.page.how.phonetic: With built-in phonetic mode on you can play in Roman letters too — the engine rebuilds each word on every keystroke, so a half-typed word is never counted as a mistake.
game.page.privacy: The game runs offline like the rest of the app, and no score is ever sent anywhere.
custom.heading: Practise your own text
custom.lead: Paste an exam question, a paragraph from a book, or any Bangla text and practise it. Nothing is uploaded; it is kept in this browser.
custom.saveHint: Save it with a name to find it again later — without one, its first few words become the name.
custom.libraryFull: The library is full (20 texts). Delete one before saving another.
custom.libraryHint: See your saved texts, add another one or delete one.
custom.libraryEmpty: Nothing saved yet. Name a text above and save it to find it here later.
custom.numeralsHint: Pick the kind of digits your own keyboard produces — a passage whose numerals are the other kind can never be matched exactly.
custom.error.empty: Write or paste some Bangla text first.
custom.error.latin: Latin letters found. Use Bangla text only.
custom.error.notBangla: Something that is not Bangla is in there. Remove the emoji or the other symbols — digits in either numeral system are fine.
custom.error.tooShort: That text is too short; add a little more.
custom.error.tooLong: That text is too long; trim it down.
custom.error.wordRange: The word count is outside the limit.
custom.saved: Your text is stored in this browser.
custom.storageUnavailable: This browser cannot store your text, so it will be gone after a reload.
